name: Lists Integrations
description: Displays demon list rankings (AREDL, Narll, Demonlist, etc.) directly on levels in-game. Configurable via URL.

show-badges.name: Show List Badges
show-badges.description: Display list badges on levels that appear on demon lists.

show-rank.name: Show Rank Number
show-rank.description: Show the level's rank number alongside the list badge.

aredl-enabled.name: Enable AREDL
aredl-enabled.description: Fetch rankings from the All Rated Extreme Demon List.

aredl-url.name: AREDL API URL
aredl-url.description: API endpoint for AREDL level data.

narll-enabled.name: Enable NARLL
narll-enabled.description: Fetch rankings from the Not Another Rated Level List.

narll-url.name: NARLL API URL
narll-url.description: API endpoint for NARLL level data.

demonlist-enabled.name: Enable Pointercrate Demonlist
demonlist-enabled.description: Fetch rankings from the Pointercrate Demonlist.

demonlist-url.name: Demonlist API URL
demonlist-url.description: API endpoint for Demonlist level data.

custom-list-enabled.name: Enable Custom List
custom-list-enabled.description: Fetch rankings from a custom list API.

custom-list-name.name: Custom List Name
custom-list-name.description: Display name for your custom list.

custom-list-url.name: Custom List API URL
custom-list-url.description: Full URL to a JSON API returning level data. Must return an array with 'id' and 'position' fields.

badge-position.name: Badge Position
badge-position.description: Where to display the list badge on the level cell.

cache-duration.name: Cache Duration (minutes)
cache-duration.description: How long to cache list data before re-fetching. Higher = less requests.
